1→# Pinzo — Shopify App Project Brain
     2→
     3→## Stack (Exact Versions)
     4→- **Framework:** React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
     5→- **UI:** Shopify Polaris v13 (`@shopify/polaris`) — use ONLY Polaris components, never raw HTML for layout
     6→- **App Bridge:** `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4 — for all Shopify admin UI interactions
     7→- **Auth:** `shopify.server.ts` → `authenticate.admin(request)` — required before every Shopify API call
     8→- **Database:** Prisma v6 + SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
     9→- **Language:** TypeScript everywhere — zero plain `.js` files allowed
    10→- **Bundler:** Vite v6
    11→- **Node:** ≥20.19
    12→
    13→## Folder Structure
    14→```
    15→app/
    16→  routes/           ← All file-based routes
    17→  billing.server.ts ← Billing/subscription logic
    18→  db.server.ts      ← Prisma client singleton
    19→  plans.ts          ← Pricing plan definitions (Free/Pro/Ultimate)
    20→  shopify.server.ts ← Shopify auth + API setup
    21→  root.tsx          ← Root component
    22→  entry.server.tsx  ← Server entry
    23→prisma/
    24→  schema.prisma     ← Database schema
    25→  migrations/       ← Migration history
    26→.claude/
    27→  settings.json     ← Shared permissions config
    28→  commands/         ← Slash commands (/feature, /fix, /review)
    29→  agents/           ← Specialized agents (builder, bug-fixer)
    30→```
    31→
    32→## Database Models (Prisma)
    33→- **Session** — Shopify OAuth session storage (do NOT modify)
    34→- **ZipCode** — shop, zipCode, label, zone, message, eta, type (allowed/blocked)
    35→- **DeliveryRule** — shop, name, zone, zipCodes, minOrderAmount, deliveryFee, freeShippingAbove, estimatedDays, cutoffTime, daysOfWeek, priority
    36→- **WaitlistEntry** — shop, email, zipCode, note, status (waiting/notified/converted)
    37→- **WidgetConfig** — shop, position, colors, heading, placeholder, buttonText, messages, borderRadius, customCss
    38→- **Subscription** — shop, planId, billingInterval, shopifySubscriptionId, status, trialEndsAt
    39→
    40→## Route Patterns
    41→| Route Pattern | Purpose |
    42→|---|---|
    43→| `app._index.tsx` | Dashboard |
    44→| `app.*.tsx` | Admin pages (require authenticate.admin) |
    45→| `api.*.tsx` | Public API endpoints (storefront widget) |
    46→| `webhooks.*.tsx` | Webhook handlers |
    47→| `auth.*.tsx` | OAuth flow (do NOT modify) |
    48→
    49→## Architecture Rules
    50→1. **Auth first** — always call `authenticate.admin(request)` before any Shopify API usage
    51→2. **Loaders/actions only** — Shopify API calls ONLY inside loaders and actions, never inside components
    52→3. **Polaris only** — use ONLY Polaris v13 components for all UI inside `app.*` routes
    53→4. **Public APIs** — `api.*` routes serve the storefront widget (no auth required, return JSON)
    54→5. **Webhooks** — handle idempotently, return 200 quickly, no heavy processing inline
    55→6. **DB access** — import `db` from `~/db.server` for all Prisma operations
    56→7. **Billing** — use `billing.server.ts` for all subscription checks and plan changes
    57→8. **Plans** — reference `plans.ts` for plan IDs and feature flags
    58→
    59→## UI Rules (Polaris v13)
    60→- Layout: `Page`, `Layout`, `Layout.Section`, `Card`, `BlockStack`, `InlineStack`
    61→- Data: `DataTable`, `IndexTable`, `ResourceList`
    62→- Forms: `Form`, `FormLayout`, `TextField`, `Select`, `Checkbox`
    63→- Feedback: `Toast` for user-facing errors and success, `Banner` for persistent alerts
    64→- Loading: `SkeletonPage`, `SkeletonBodyText`, `SkeletonDisplayText` — always add loading states
    65→- Modals: `Modal` component with `active` prop
    66→- Navigation: use App Bridge `useNavigate` for in-app navigation
    67→
    68→## Code Rules
    69→- Fix ALL TypeScript errors before marking anything done — run `npm run typecheck`
    70→- Error handling on every async operation (try/catch in actions/loaders)
    71→- Never use raw `fetch()` for Shopify API — use the graphql client from `authenticate.admin()`
    72→- Before writing new code: read 2-3 existing similar route files and match their exact pattern
    73→- No `any` types — use proper TypeScript types or infer from Prisma
    74→- `useActionData`, `useLoaderData` for data in components — never fetch inside components
    75→
    76→## Commands
    77→```bash
    78→npm run dev          # Start dev server via Shopify CLI
    79→npm run build        # Build for production
    80→npm run typecheck    # TypeScript validation (run after every change)
    81→npm run lint         # ESLint check
    82→npm run setup        # Prisma generate + migrate (first time)
    83→npx prisma studio    # Visual DB browser
    84→npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>   # Create new migration
    85→npx shopify app deploy                  # Deploy to Shopify
    86→```
    87→
    88→## When Building a Feature — Always Follow This Order
    89→1. Read CLAUDE.md (this file) — understand rules
    90→2. Read 2-3 existing similar route files (e.g. `app.zip-codes.tsx`, `app.settings.tsx`)
    91→3. Build the route file: `loader` (fetch data) + `action` (handle mutations) + default export component
    92→4. Use only Polaris v13 for all UI
    93→5. Add error handling in action with try/catch, return errors via `json()`
    94→6. Add loading states with Polaris Skeleton components
    95→7. Run `npm run typecheck` — fix every error before finishing
    96→8. List all files created and what to test
    97→
    98→## Existing Feature Reference
    99→- ZIP code CRUD → `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
   100→- Delivery rules → `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`
   101→- Waitlist viewer → `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
   102→- Widget config → `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`
   103→- Billing/pricing → `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx` + `app/billing.server.ts`
   104→- Settings → `app/routes/app.settings.tsx`
   105→- Public ZIP API → `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx`
   106→- Public widget config API → `app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx`
   107→- Waitlist signup API → `app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx`

1→# Pinzo — Shopify App
     2→
     3→A Shopify embedded app that lets merchants control delivery availability by zip code. Built with React Router 7, Shopify Polaris, and Prisma.
     4→
     5→## Features
     6→
     7→- **Zip Code Management** — Add, edit, activate/deactivate allowed and blocked zip codes
     8→- **Delivery Zones & ETAs** — Group zip codes into zones with estimated delivery times
     9→- **Delivery Rules** — Zone-based rules for fees, minimum order amounts, cutoff times, and schedules
    10→- **Customer Waitlist** — Capture emails from unsupported areas and notify when coverage expands
    11→- **Widget Customisation** — Style the storefront zip code checker widget without touching code
    12→- **Billing** — Free, Pro, and Ultimate plans via Shopify App Subscriptions
    13→
    14→## Tech Stack
    15→
    16→- [React Router 7](https://reactrouter.com) (full-stack)
    17→- [Shopify Polaris](https://polaris.shopify.com) v13
    18→- [Shopify App React Router](https://github.com/Shopify/shopify-app-js)
    19→- [Prisma](https://www.prisma.io) ORM (SQLite for dev, PostgreSQL for production)
    20→- TypeScript, Vite
    21→
    22→## Development
    23→
    24→### Prerequisites
    25→
    26→- Node.js ≥ 20.19
    27→- A [Shopify Partner](https://partners.shopify.com) account and development store
    28→
    29→### Setup
    30→
    31→```bash
    32→npm install
    33→npm run setup        # prisma generate + migrate
    34→npm run dev          # shopify app dev
    35→```
    36→
    37→### Scripts
    38→
    39→| Command | Description |
    40→|---------|-------------|
    41→| `npm run dev` | Start local dev server via Shopify CLI |
    42→| `npm run build` | Build for production |
    43→| `npm run start` | Serve the built app |
    44→| `npm run setup` | Generate Prisma client and run migrations |
    45→| `npm run deploy` | Deploy to Shopify |
    46→| `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript type checking |
    47→| `npm run lint` | ESLint |
    48→
    49→## Production Database
    50→
    51→Switch from SQLite to PostgreSQL for production:
    52→
    53→1. Update `prisma/schema.prisma`:
    54→   ```prisma
    55→   datasource db {
    56→     provider = "postgresql"
    57→     url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
    58→   }
    59→   ```
    60→2. Set `DATABASE_URL` to your PostgreSQL connection string
    61→3. Run `npm run setup`
    62→
    63→## Public API
    64→
    65→The storefront widget calls a public endpoint to check zip code availability:
    66→
    67→```
    68→GET /api/zip-check?shop=store.myshopify.com&zip=12345
    69→POST /api/zip-check  { "shop": "store.myshopify.com", "zip": "12345" }
    70→```
    71→
    72→Response:
    73→```json
    74→{ "allowed": true, "message": "We deliver to your area!", "eta": "2-3 days", "zone": "North" }
    75→```
    76→
    77→## GDPR Compliance
    78→
    79→The app implements all three mandatory GDPR webhooks required by Shopify:
    80→
    81→- `customers/data_request` — logs customer data requests for manual fulfilment
    82→- `customers/redact` — deletes customer PII (waitlist entries)
    83→- `shop/redact` — deletes all shop data 48 hours after uninstall
    84→
    85→## Shopify App Store
    86→
    87→This app is designed for submission to the Shopify App Store and follows all [Shopify app requirements](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/app-requirements).
    88→# Pinzo
    89→

## Comprehensive Pinzo Shopify App Exploration

I've completed a thorough exploration of the Pinzo project. Here's the full breakdown:

---

### 1. **WHAT THE APP DOES**

Pinzo is a Shopify embedded admin app that lets merchants control delivery availability by ZIP code. Key capabilities:

- **ZIP Code Management** — Add/edit/activate/deactivate allowed and blocked ZIP codes
- **Delivery Zones & ETAs** — Group ZIP codes into zones with estimated delivery times
- **Delivery Rules** — Zone-based rules for fees, minimum order amounts, cutoff times, day-of-week schedules
- **Customer Waitlist** — Capture emails from unsupported areas; bulk notify when coverage expands
- **Widget Customization** — Style the storefront ZIP code checker widget (colors, text, layout, custom CSS)
- **Billing** — Multi-tier SaaS: Free / Starter / Pro / Ultimate with monthly/annual options
- **Feature Requests** — Community voting system for feature ideas (all plans)
- **GDPR Compliance** — Mandatory webhooks: `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`

---

### 2. **TECH STACK & ARCHITECTURE**

**Core Stack:**
- **Framework:** React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
- **UI Library:** Shopify Polaris v13 (`@shopify/polaris`)
- **App Bridge:** `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4
- **Database:** Prisma v6 with PostgreSQL (production) / SQLite (dev)
- **Language:** TypeScript (strict mode, zero `.js` files)
- **Bundler:** Vite v6
- **Node:** ≥20.19

**API & Auth:**
- Shopify Admin API (January 2026 = `2026-01`)
- OAuth via `shopify.server.ts` → `authenticate.admin(request)`
- Session storage: Prisma session storage
- Public APIs for storefront widget (no auth required)

### 4. **DATABASE SCHEMA (Prisma)**

File: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/prisma/schema.prisma`

**Models:**

| Model | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| **Session** | Shopify OAuth session storage (managed by Shopify, do NOT modify) |
| **ZipCode** | shop, zipCode, label, zone, message, eta, type (allowed/blocked), isActive, codAvailable, returnPolicy, createdAt, updatedAt. Unique: (shop, zipCode) |
| **DeliveryRule** | shop, name, zone, zipCodes (CSV), minOrderAmount, deliveryFee, freeShippingAbove, estimatedDays, cutoffTime, daysOfWeek, isActive, priority, timestamps. Indexed by shop |
| **WaitlistEntry** | shop, name, email, zipCode, note, status (waiting/notified/converted), timestamps. Unique: (shop, email, zipCode). Indexed by shop |
| **WidgetConfig** | shop (unique), position, colors (primary, success, error, bg, text), text (heading, placeholder, buttonText, messages), features (showEta, showZone, showWaitlist, etc.), borderRadius, customCss, timestamps |
| **Subscription** | shop (unique), planId, billingInterval (monthly/annual), shopifySubscriptionId, status, trialEndsAt, timestamps |
| **ShopSettings** | shop (unique), shopName, defaultBehavior (block/allow), notificationEmail, emailSenderName, emailReplyTo, timestamps |
| **FeatureRequest** | id, title, description, category, status, shop (submitter), votesCount (denormalized), timestamps. Relations: votes (one-to-many). Indexed: status, votesCount |
| **FeatureVote** | featureRequestId, shop, createdAt. Unique: (featureRequestId, shop). Indexed: shop. Cascade delete on feature |

**Database Provider:** PostgreSQL (production) — Railway hosted at `hopper.proxy.rlwy.net:53858`
